INSERT INTO link_stats_dim_daily (tenant_id, link_id, day, dim_type, dim_value, pv, uv, updated_at) VALUES
(#{r.tenantId}, #{r.linkId}, #{r.day}, #{r.dimType}, #{r.dimValue}, #{r.pv}, #{r.uv}, NOW())
